overrides.purpose: Minimal system-fix successor to the failed V22 Pilot. V23 preserves the baseline model, temperature, complete state/card/legal-action context, CoT route policy, memory semantics, retrieval, injection schedule, and reflection schedule. It replaces only the Cartesian repetition of identical injection-event evidence with an exactly reversible event-centered representation, and gives reflection requests a dedicated two-full-attempt transport envelope without changing the action transport policy. V22 remains an immutable historical artifact.

memory.reflection_exposure_representation_contr: Each injection event is serialized once with every original field plus explicit memory_id, entry_version, and memory_event_index associations. The old per-memory map must be reconstructed exactly before every provider request or the request fails closed.
memory.reflection_transport_budget_contract: Reflection uses at most two complete 180-second provider attempts separated by the inherited 10-second backoff inside a 420-second logical deadline. Baseline action requests retain the inherited V21 240-second policy unchanged.
